summary: Generic non-panel, non-3D component for packaging internal operator networks, custom parameters, extensions, clone relationships, and external .tox modules without adding a control panel or object transform surface.

key_params.name: reinitextensions
key_params.note: Recompile extension objects attached to this component.

key_params.name: initextonstart
key_params.note: Automatically re-initialize extensions when TouchDesigner starts.

key_params.name: ext
key_params.note: Sequence of extension definitions for the component.

key_params.name: ext0object
key_params.note: Class instance attached as an extension object.

key_params.name: ext0name
key_params.note: Optional extension lookup name instead of the class name.

key_params.name: ext0promote
key_params.note: Expose extension members directly on the component instead of only through .ext.

key_params.name: opshortcut

key_params.name: iop

common_gotchas: Base COMP intentionally has no panel parameters and no 3D object parameters; choose Container/List/Table/Text/Widget COMPs for panel behavior and Object COMPs for renderable 3D transforms.
Promote controls whether extension members are reached directly on the component or through the .ext member, so scripts should use the access path that matches the component's extension policy.
External .tox loading falls back to what the .toe was saved with if the .tox cannot be found; Save Backup of External makes that fallback explicit for moved or missing component files.
Load on Demand saves memory for components that are not always used, but delayed loading can surprise startup scripts that assume children are already resident.
Reload Custom Parameters and Reload Built-In Parameters affect only top-level component parameters; nodes inside the component are always reloaded with the external .tox contents.
